items.text: You asked: does using an agent cost me anything? No. We're paid by the carrier, and your rate is the same whether you enroll with us or by yourself. You just get a person to call. (571) 354-0146

"What do you charge?" is the question we get most, so here is the plain answer: nothing.

Independent agents are compensated by the insurance carrier when a policy is placed. Your rate is set by the carrier and filed with the state - it does not go up because you used an agent, and it does not go down because you skipped one.

What you get for it is a person who is accountable to you at claim time, at renewal, and when something changes. Not a call center queue.

The fair follow-up question is: if the carrier pays you, whose side are you on? That is why independence matters. We represent many carriers rather than one, so we are not steering you toward a single company's shelf.

Honorbrook Insurance - Luay Sadqi, NPN 21370662. honorbrook-insurance.com
